calculate_td_learning_error: calculate the TD-learning temporal difference error from state values, reward, discount, and next state value
calculate_q_learning_error: calculate the Q-learning temporal difference error using Q-values, action index, reward, and discount factor
calculate_sarsa_error: calculate the SARSA temporal difference error from current and next Q-values with action indices
calculate_retrace_offpolicy_error: calculate the Retrace off-policy temporal difference error with importance weights and lambda mixing
compute_categorical_q_learning_loss: compute categorical Q-learning loss by projecting shifted value distributions onto target atoms
